units.source_text: 正想着呢，手电筒把他包围起来，一边向左右散开，一边慢慢地缩短距离逼过来。

en.t: Just as he was thinking this, the flashlights surrounded him, spreading out to the left and right while slowly closing in.

units.source_text: 他把所有力量集中在抓绳索的手臂上，腰里再加一点弹性，他很难作出决断，只把指甲毫无用处地扎进脆弱的地面。

en.t: He concentrated all his strength in the arm gripping the rope and added a little spring from his waist, but he could not make up his mind and only drove his fingernails uselessly into the fragile ground.

units.source_text: 散开的手电筒之间，闪动着几个影影绰绰的人影。

en.t: Among the scattered flashlights, several vague human figures flickered into view.

units.source_text: 况且，道旁那看起来像洞穴的暗影，分明就是一辆三轮摩托车。

en.t: Besides, the dark shape by the roadside that had looked like a cave was clearly a three-wheeled motorcycle.

units.source_text: 就算这一次冲出重围，后面立刻就会追上来吧。

en.t: Even if he broke through the encirclement this time, they would immediately catch up from behind.

units.source_text: 身后传来停止哭闹的孩子奔跑的声音。

en.t: From behind him came the sound of the child, no longer crying, running.

units.source_text: 忽地，灵机一动，有了个绝妙的想法：抓住孩子当挡箭牌！

en.t: Suddenly, inspiration struck, and a brilliant idea came to him: grab the child and use him as a shield!

units.source_text: 把孩子当人质，能够阻止那些家伙的接近！

en.t: If he took the child hostage, he could stop those people from coming closer!

units.source_text: ……可是，回过头正想去追，谁知又有别的光在那边等着。

en.t: ...But just as he turned around to give chase, another light was waiting over there.
